en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; it reads like a modern town song, but I cannot name an author. 'на увце' is my reading: played right into the ear.

lines.cyr: Цел' ноќ во кафеани седиш, Дуле мајсторе,
lines.lat: Cel' noḱ vo kafeani sediš, Dule majstore,
lines.en: All night you sit in taverns, Dule the master craftsman,

lines.cyr: на свирачи бакшиш делиш, море мангупе.
lines.lat: na svirači bakšiš deliš, more mangupe.
lines.en: you hand out tips to the musicians, hey you rogue.

lines.cyr: Многу сакаш да ти свират тивко, на увце
lines.lat: Mnogu sakaš da ti svirat tivko, na uvce
lines.en: You like them to play softly for you, in your ear,

lines.cyr: и на маса да ти пеат, море ѓаволе.
lines.lat: i na masa da ti peat, more ǵavole.
lines.en: and to sing at your table, hey you devil.

lines.cyr: Дуле, Дуле, Дуле бре, вредно мајсторче,
lines.lat: Dule, Dule, Dule bre, vredno majstorče,
lines.en: Dule, Dule, Dule hey, hard-working young master,

lines.cyr: чувај си ја жената, море будалче.
lines.lat: čuvaj si ja ženata, more budalče.
lines.en: watch over your wife, hey you silly fool.

lines.cyr: Ако Дуле побргу не си дојдеш ти,
lines.lat: Ako Dule pobrgu ne si dojdeš ti,
lines.en: If you don't come home sooner, Dule,

lines.cyr: тука е комшијата да ја утеши.
lines.lat: tuka e komšijata da ja uteši.
lines.en: the neighbor is right here to console her.

lines.cyr: Жена ти те чека Дуле, да си дојдеш ти,
lines.lat: Žena ti te čeka Dule, da si dojdeš ti,
lines.en: Your wife is waiting for you, Dule, for you to come,

lines.cyr: а ти скиташ цели ноќи по кафеани.
lines.lat: a ti skitaš celi noḱi po kafeani.
lines.en: and you wander whole nights through the taverns.

lines.cyr: Ни за жена, ни за куќа гајле не ти е,
lines.lat: Ni za žena, ni za kuḱa gajle ne ti e,
lines.en: You care neither for wife nor for house,

lines.cyr: само да се свирачите вечно со тебе.
lines.lat: samo da se sviračite večno so tebe.
lines.en: as long as the musicians are with you forever.

lines.cyr: Дуле, Дуле, Дуле бре, вредно мајсторче,
lines.lat: Dule, Dule, Dule bre, vredno majstorče,
lines.en: Dule, Dule, Dule hey, hard-working young master,

lines.en: watch over your wife, hey you silly fool.
